Mohd Hawarie Bin Tan Muzi (born 30 September 1980) is a Malaysian entrepreneur in the construction and facilities management sector. He is the Group Chief Executive Officer of AHB Strategic Holdings Sdn. Bhd. and Ali Husin & Bros Group (AHB Group), based in Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia.
Early life and education
Mohd Hawarie was born in Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia. He received his early education at Sekolah Rendah Cator Avenue and later attended Sekolah Menengah Anderson, Ipoh. He later obtained a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Universiti Geomatika Malaysia.
He also holds:
* Malaysian Skills Certificate (SKM) in Marine Skill Engine from Akademi Laut Malaysia (ALAM)
* Diploma in Management from Kolej Asa
Career
Early career
He began his career in the maritime industry with Malaysia International Shipping Corporation (MISC), where he gained experience in technical operations and engineering management.
He later served in the Malaysian public sector, including roles within the Ministry of Housing and Local Government (KPKT) and the Ministry of Rural and Regional Development (KKLW).
Business leadership
Mohd Hawarie is the founder and Group Chief Executive Officer of AHB Group, a company involved in residential construction and facilities management. The company focuses on building houses on individually owned land.
He has also commented on construction cost increases and industry challenges in Malaysian media.
The company has also announced expansion plans and phased investments to strengthen operations.
AHB Group has been reported for its focus on helping customers build houses on their own land.
Contribution
He has advocated for greater transparency in construction costs to help the public better understand the actual cost of building houses.
In 2025, he and AHB Group were involved in preparing house designs for the Rumah Perakku Prihatin initiative under the Perak Foundation. The design was used in 2026 as a model for a house construction assistance program for low-income groups in the state of Perak.
He was also quoted in media regarding a potential 40 percent increase in construction costs that could affect housing prices in Malaysia.
He also commented on rising construction costs, which were reported to increase by up to 40 percent and potentially affect housing prices in Malaysia.
Mohd Hawarie has provided commentary on housing affordability, construction costs, and contractor industry issues in Malaysian media including New Straits Times (NST) , Harian Metro, Utusan Malaysia and Kosmo.
Recognition
* Bumiputera Business Excellence Awards (BBEA) 2025
